title: His father in the Onward, Pickwood and Excelsior bands
summary: His father played baritone in the old Onward, Pickwood and Excelsior bands. His last parade was the 10th of May Oddfellows day.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: He played baritone. He played baritone in the old Onward band. The original Onward, the old Onward, way back in 1880 something. And then he played a while, he used to play with the Pickwood band and also the Excelsior. But after he passed, why different men in that band began to pass and he taken sick and died. Now his last parade was the 10th of May parade. My mother used to tell me that all the time. It was the 10th of May. And he came home and he taken the bed and never got up no more. That was in May and he died that September. What's the meaning of the 10th of May?

Well that's a day that the Oddfellas, that used to be an Oddfellas day here. Years ago when I was a boy, that used to call that Oddfellas day. The 10th of May, regardless to what day it fell on, that was their day. It was Sunday or Monday or any day, that was their day. And they, in the later years, I don't know, they just changed it into the second Sunday in May. They still have it in May, but they changed it to the second Sunday in May. They don't have the 10th of May anymore, unless that Sunday falls on the 10th.
